entities.name: Holger Burk
entities.description: A master silversmith of Innistrad cursed to become a werewolf, who sacrificed himself in an attack on Thraben Cathedral.

entities.name: Adila Rimheit
entities.description: Leader of a church in Kessig that harbored and researched werewolves.

entities.name: Raben Amsel
entities.description: Holger's ally whose mission Holger's sacrifice aimed to aid.

entities.name: Order of the Silver Hammer
entities.description: Esteemed order of silversmiths Holger was inducted into.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Region of Innistrad with the church Holger took refuge in.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Site of the werewolf attack in which Holger died.

events.summary: On a trip to finalize a deal, Holger is attacked and cursed by werewolves.
events.quote: he was attacked and cursed by werewolves

events.summary: Isolated from his family, Holger seeks refuge in a church in Kessig led by Adila Rimheit.
events.quote: leading him to seek refuge in a church in Kessig

events.summary: Holger realizes there is no cure and joins Adila's cause.
events.quote: Holger eventually realized there was no way to return to his former life.

events.summary: Holger sacrifices himself in a werewolf attack on Thraben Cathedral to buy time for Raben Amsel.
events.quote: Holger sacrificed himself in a werewolf attack on Thraben Cathedral

relations.quote: his wife, Adalee, and their children, Jana and Mikel
hoping to buy time for his ally, Raben Amsel
